batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU A Unit 2014-2015 admission paper whose printed header reads SET CODE: 1 (the Drive listing 'Set-1' agrees with the print for this file). 80 questions: General Knowledge 8 (Q1-8), English 3 (Q9-11), Bangla 3 (Q12-14), Chemistry 22 (Q15-36), Physics 22 (Q37-58), Higher Mathematics 22 (Q59-80) — subjects assigned by content in the paper's printed sequence (no subject headings printed). Keys are the compiler's boxed 'Ans: X' tags printed beside the options or at the end of each question's worked solution (with a printed Solve:/ব্যাখ্যা for most Physics/Higher Mathematics and many Chemistry questions), not an official JU key. Two printed no-correct-option dispositions: Q43 ('Ans: Nil' — the Solve's value 1082 K is not among the options) and Q59 ('Ans: Nil', although the Solve concludes x = 1, y = -2 = option A — conflict documented on the question). Two keyless questions: Q36 (boxed key letter wholly covered by the opaque watermark logo) and Q58 (key box printed dashed, 'Ans: ----'). Two box-vs-solve key conflicts (Q50, Q69) and one pair of conflicting key boxes (Q53) are preserved with the boxed/Solve-supported reading recorded and the conflict documented on each question. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions content-unverified; keyed answers answer-unverified; the two dispositions carry answer status 'verified' only because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit (Faculty of Mathematical & Physical Sciences) 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2014-2015, SET CODE 1 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (diagonal 'ADMISSION WAR' watermark with red 'ADMISSION' lettering and an orange/blue book logo; banners 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' / 'Get all University Info From www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner' footers). Each question carries a boxed 'Ans: X' key; Physics/Higher Mathematics questions print a full 'Solve:' (often with a boxed data summary), Chemistry questions a short ব্যাখ্যা or a 'Solve:' line. Renders: ocr/pages/jua1415s1/p-1..8.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi, 5166x7310); p-1 render sha256 141f737b4855c5b9f74320f9f538a5a67d3e826da5934413a6dc8ed2f855cfbb. Key obscurations: Q2's and Q3's key letters are partly covered by the watermark logo and were read on enlarged dark-/colour-channel crops (Q3's survives only as an arc, read as C); Q36's key letter is wholly covered and is NOT recorded (question keyless). Handwritten candidate marks (circled '4' on p.1) were ignored.

papers.title: JU A Unit Admission Test 2014-2015 — Set Code 1 (AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan; Drive listing 'Set-1')

examRules.sourceNote: Transcribed from the compilation's printed header (PDF p.1): জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; A-ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ; ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; সময়ঃ ৫৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০; boxed set label 'SET CODE: 1'. Printed instructions: প্রশ্নপত্রে ৮০টি প্রশ্ন আছে, সকল প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হবে, প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে; কোন ধরনের ক্যালকুলেটর ব্যবহার করা যাবে না; পরীক্ষা শেষে উত্তরপত্র (OMR) এর সাথে প্রশ্নপত্রও কর্তব্যরত সম্মানিত শিক্ষকের নিকট জমা দিতে হবে; OMR উত্তরপত্রের নির্ধারিত 'ক' ও 'খ' স্থানে দুটি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — (ক) আমাদের ছোট নদী চলে বাঁকে বাঁকে (খ) 'Honesty is the best policy'. A circled handwritten '4' beside the header is a candidate's mark, not print, and does not change the printed code.
